target_audience.demographics: Young adults, families, and working professionals aged 18–45 in Pakistan
target_audience.psychographics: Enjoy flavorful grilled food, active on Instagram and food delivery apps, look for filling meals with strong flavors and good value
pain_points: Need for consistent quality and generous portions

competitors_or_market: Local barbecue restaurants and food delivery services in Pakistan
unique_value_proposition: Authentic charcoal grilling with bold marinades, fresh preparation, generous portions, and a focus on strong smoky flavor and consistent quality.
additional_context: FirePit BBQ Co. emphasizes shareable platters and combo meals for groups, aiming to build a loyal customer base through consistent flavor, good portions, and reliable delivery service.
